from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


def _fresh_app(tmp_path: Path):
    app_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    database = tmp_path / "oracle.db"
    previous = __import__("os").environ.get("YONGHU_DATABASE_PATH")
    __import__("os").environ["YONGHU_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(database)
    for module_name in ("main", "database_config", "user_router", "user_service"):
        __import__("sys").modules.pop(module_name, None)
    main = importlib.import_module("main")
    main.init_db()
    client = TestClient(main.app, raise_server_exceptions=False)
    return client, database, previous


def test_apostrophe_username_round_trip(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    client, database, previous = _fresh_app(tmp_path)
    try:
        username = "O'Brien"
        created = client.post("/api/yonghu/yonghu", json={"username": username, "email": "apostrophe@example.invalid", "status": "1"})
        assert created.status_code == 200, created.text
        user_id = created.json()["id"]
        detail = client.get(f"/api/yonghu/yonghu/{user_id}")
        assert detail.status_code == 200, detail.text
        assert detail.json()["username"] == username
        connection = sqlite3.connect(database)
        try:
            row = connection.execute("SELECT username FROM yonghu WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone()
            assert row == (username,)
        finally:
            connection.close()
    finally:
        if previous is None:
            __import__("os").environ.pop("YONGHU_DATABASE_PATH", None)
        else:
            __import__("os").environ["YONGHU_DATABASE_PATH"] = previous

    app_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

    app_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

    previous = __import__("os").environ.get("YONGHU_DATABASE_PATH")

    app_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

    previous = __import__("os").environ.get("YONGHU_DATABASE_PATH")

    client, database, previous = _fresh_app(tmp_path)

        try:
